svg.title: Estro supporting product flows
svg.desc: A dark structural wireframe board showing Estro's Landing, Project Hub, Create and Import, Export and Job Center, and Review workspaces, connected through a persistent editor project context.
svg.text: Five structural destinations connected by one project revision, one job system, and a reliable return to the editor.

g.text: Revision, history, jobs, and agent activity persist

svg.text: with direct controls and agent help
